purpose: Evidence-Contrast U-PCR/DUFS-LIU: teacher-forced rescoring of fixed RAGTruth responses under full/no-context/leave-one-chunk-out evidence conditions, for response-level grounding detection and span localization

scorer.note: OFF-POLICY scoring -- this scorer is NOT any of RAGTruth's 6 original generator models (gpt-4-0613, gpt-3.5-turbo-0613, mistral-7B-instruct, llama-2-{7b,13b,70b}-chat). Chosen to match the scorer class GASP used, for protocol comparability with the closest direct competitor.
scorer.repetition_penalty_trap: Qwen2.5-Instruct's generation_config default is 1.05; the campaign's teacher-forced passes use warpers=None with no rep_penalty (correct, since there is no warp of OURS to mirror for someone else's fixed response). Gate B validates this exact code path via a repetition_penalty=1.0 generated cell (preset gateb_gsm8k_qwen25_15b).

protocol.corpus: RAGTruth (Niu et al. 2024, ACL) -- data/ragtruth_protocol/PROVENANCE.md, pinned commit c103204b9ce28d6bbad859304bf30de72b8ed8fe
protocol.unit: teacher-forced rescoring of a FIXED published response; nothing is generated
protocol.conditions: full context, no context, leave-one-chunk-out (per-task-type chunking: QA=3 passages, Data2txt=9 top-level JSON fields, Summary=1 whole-document chunk -- see PROVENANCE.md for why Summary has no sub-structure in this corpus)
protocol.prompt_construction: prompt surgery on the ORIGINAL published prompt (source_info.jsonl's `prompt` field) -- the evidence substring is edited in place, never reconstructed from a template
protocol.split_round_1: test split (2,700 responses, 16,200 (response,condition) items) + a 150-source_id dev slice drawn from train
protocol.splits_and_bootstrap: grouped by source_id (never by response row) -- up to 6 responses share one source

frozen_arm_roster.1_full_context_only_dufs_liu: no evidence interventions; core-five token views from the 'full' pass only
frozen_arm_roster.2_likelihood_drop_baseline: mean(NLL_noctx - NLL_full), the simplest evidence-sensitivity score
frozen_arm_roster.3_gasp_reproduction: faithful reproduction of GASP's likelihood-change / JS-divergence perturbation score on the SAME teacher-forced passes (scripts/rag_ec_v1/gasp.py; fidelity level declared per the tailor-not-transplant convention)
frozen_arm_roster.4_ec_upcr: evidence-contrast views fused with the deployed U-PCR solver
frozen_arm_roster.5_ec_dufs_liu_temporal: evidence-contrast views fused with DUFS-LIU, temporal-chain Laplacian (default arm)
frozen_arm_roster.5b_ec_dufs_liu_evidence_graph: evidence-contrast views fused with DUFS-LIU, EXOGENOUS evidence graph (nodes=intervention views, edges=TF-IDF chunk-text similarity) -- the new graph construction this campaign tests
frozen_arm_roster.6_fusion_isolation_ablation: EC views + naive average, NOT U-PCR/DUFS-LIU -- THE NOVELTY CLAIM RESTS ON ROW 5/5b BEATING THIS ROW, since GASP already does evidence perturbation; unsupervised fusion of dependent contrasts is the only claimed contribution beyond GASP

named_competitors.dataset_subset: RAGTruth (response + span AUROC), TofuEval (transfer), short-answer RAGBench (falsification)
named_competitors.protocol: fixed-answer evidence perturbation: full/no-context/leave-one-passage-out likelihood changes + JS divergence
named_competitors.supervision_access_sampling: training-free, gray-box, multi-pass (m+2 conditions per response)
named_competitors.comparison_level: 1 (same exact outputs, RAGTruth published responses) for the faithful reproduction arm; 2 (same protocol) if scorer model differs from GASP's own choice
named_competitors.published_numbers: ~0.73 response AUROC / ~0.67 span AUROC on RAGTruth

named_competitors.protocol: claim decomposition + external verification against context
named_competitors.supervision_access_sampling: external verifier model + claim decomposition, not gray-box
named_competitors.comparison_level: 3 (same dataset only) -- quoted as an external-verifier ceiling, not rerun

named_competitors.protocol: ModernBERT token classifier over context-question-answer triples
named_competitors.comparison_level: 3 (same dataset only) -- quoted as a supervised ceiling, not rerun

mandatory_competitor_gate.comparison_level_definition: 1=same exact outputs, 2=same protocol/new sampling, 3=same dataset only (docs/research_notes/external_data_collection_plan_2026.md)

gate_b.requires: a GENERATED greedy Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct cell with repetition_penalty=1.0 forced, gen_token_ids + token_entropies saved

sequence: 1. local smokes: spectral_utils.ragtruth.smoke(), scripts/rag_ec_v1/smoke_ragtruth.py, smoke_preset.py gateb_gsm8k_qwen25_15b
2. bash cluster/sync_code.sh; push data/ragtruth_protocol/ explicitly (untracked, not in sync_code's tar)
3. submit gateb_gsm8k_qwen25_15b (N=100 greedy, repetition_penalty=1.0) via submit_inference.sbatch
4. Gate B: submit_conditional_rescore.sbatch --model Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct --validate --validate-pkl <gateb raw pkl> --validate-dataset gsm8k --validate-n 20
5. N=30 pilot stratified over 3 task types x all distinct conditions (~150-200 passes); gate on alignment/chunking/direction sanity
6. full test split (~16,200 passes) + dev slice, chained --dependency=afterany walls
7. fetch, schema-validate (scripts/rag_ec_v1/inspect_conditional_cell.py), freeze hash, then scripts/rag_ec_v1/run.py
